views: 200% zoom of a 1280 window (= 640 CSS px)
400% zoom of a 1280 window (= 320 CSS px, WCAG reflow)
method: Each screen is opened, then the viewport is resized through every view and document.documentElement.scrollWidth is compared with clientWidth (pass = scrollWidth <= clientWidth). Browser zoom is emulated by the CSS-pixel width it produces. axe-core 4.14.0 runs at 768 and 1280 px.
